## Overview

crews v3.19.0 shipped the `review-mail` "overview" header — a default-on compact
summary emitted on the three mailbox-drain surfaces (`review-mail` JSON, `/wake`,
and the listener `type:"messages"` envelope), produced by
`lib/review-kind-summary.js`. It shipped a **simpler schema** than the
operator-approved plan that specified the feature
(`.ralph/jobs/crews-review-mail-overview-summary-header/plan.md` @ 9fc95c89,
sections 3(c) + Acceptance Criteria AC1–AC8). The under-shipment was discovered by
dogfooding the feature itself.

This task makes the shipped overview **conform** to the approved richer, lossless
schema. The primary buried-single-`done` case already works on the shipped schema
(`lastActionable` catches it), so this is a **robustness/conformance gap, not a
break**: the shipped schema exposes only `firstActionable` + `lastActionable`, so a
batch with **3+ distinct actionable entries hides the middle ones** — violating the
approved plan's central guarantee that *every* non-progress entry is surfaced.

### Shipped vs. approved — the exact delta

| Concern | SHIPPED v3.19.x | APPROVED PLAN (target) |
|---|---|---|
| Helper return shape | `{ total, actionableCount, kinds, firstActionable, lastActionable, summary }` | `{ headline, totalEntries, shownRows, senders, counts, actionableCount, needsActionCount, truncatedActionable, actionable[] }` |
| Actionable exposure | only `firstActionable` + `lastActionable` (2 descriptors) — **middle entries hidden** | FULL `actionable[]` (EVERY non-progress/non-notification entry), seq-ordered, cap-100-keep-last |
| Kind classification | **allowlist** `ACTIONABLE_KINDS` | **denylist** `NON_ACTIONABLE_KINDS` + `NEEDS_ACTION_KINDS` |
| Counts | `kinds` — counts **display rows** | `counts` — **lossless** per-literal-kind, weighted by `collapsedCount\|\|1` |
| Headline | `summary` string (old format) | `headline` string (richer format, first field) |
| Missing fields | — | `senders`, `needsActionCount`, `truncatedActionable`, `totalEntries`/`shownRows` (vs collapsed `total`) |
| Helper API | `buildReviewKindSummary(entries)` (always flattens), `reviewOverviewEnabled`, `flattenEntries`, `ACTIONABLE_KINDS` | `computeReviewKindSummary(records, opts?)` + `expandMessagesToKindRecords(messages)` (listener-only) + `parseOverviewEnv`, `NON_ACTIONABLE_KINDS`, `NEEDS_ACTION_KINDS`, `OVERVIEW_ACTIONABLE_CAP` |
| Listener enrichment | `envelope.kinds = overview.kinds` + `actionableCount`, **NOT** try/catch | `envelope.kinds = overview.counts` (lossless) + `actionableCount`, **fail-open** try/catch, counts-only |

## Research Findings

### Codebase Context
- **`lib/review-kind-summary.js`** (`:1-128`) — the shipped helper. Exports
  `ACTIONABLE_KINDS`, `buildReviewKindSummary`, `flattenEntries`,
  `reviewOverviewEnabled`. `buildReviewKindSummary(entries)` flattens first
  (`flattenEntries` expands `payload.entries[]`, `:101-120`) then returns the
  simple shape (`:75-98`). `kindOf` (`:18-30`) maps no-kind lead/member/peer (and
  any `sender`) rows to `direct`; `senderOf`/`seqOf` derive the other fields.
- **`hooks/commands/review-mail.js`** — `handler()` does
  `rows.flatMap(expandReviewRows)` -> optional `collapseReviewRows` -> formats via
  `formatReviewMailEntry` -> `result.overview = buildReviewKindSummary(entries)`
  when enabled (`:235-258, :312-315`). `formatSuccess()` inserts `overview` FIRST
  (`:319-327`). Re-exports the helper pair (`:339-362`).
- **`formatReviewMailEntry(row, opts)`** (`:105-147`) returns `{ sender, kind,
  summary, excerpt, body, bodyResolution, inboxSeq, id, seq, consumedAt }` + (when
  present) `reportId, outboxId, outboxSeq, displayPrefix, operatorDirectSummary,
  collapsedCount/collapsedSeqs/collapsedIds` — `collapsedCount` only when > 1. This
  is exactly the `records` shape the new `computeReviewKindSummary` consumes.
- **`lib/expand-review-rows.js`** (`:1-21`) — shared pure expander for
  `payload.entries[]` (adds `id, reportId, outboxId, outboxSeq, from, consumedAt,
  inboxSeq, payload`); the model for the listener's `expandMessagesToKindRecords`.
- **`lib/collapse-review-rows.js`** (`:32-84`) — collapses consecutive same-key
  rows; head rows of size > 1 get `_collapsedCount/_collapsedSeqs/_collapsedIds`,
  surfaced by review-mail.js as `collapsedCount/...` (`:137-146`). Because `kind`
  is part of the collapse key, a `done` can NEVER collapse into a `progress` run.
- **`hooks/user-prompt-submit.js`** `/wake` (`:79-84`) —
  `reviewOverviewEnabled() ? {overview: buildReviewKindSummary(entries), entries} : entries`.
- **`lib/listener-loop.js`** `deliver()` (`:474-486`) — envelope
  `{type,count,name,crew,sessionId,via}` (NO `messages` key); when enabled sets
  `envelope.kinds = overview.kinds` + `envelope.actionableCount`. **Not** wrapped in
  try/catch.

### Technical Constraints
- The richer schema is **incompatible** with the current `buildReviewKindSummary`
  result; the helper needs a full rewrite, not an extension.
- `CREWS_REVIEW_MAIL_OVERVIEW=off` must keep all three surfaces byte-identical to
  pre-feature: no top-level `overview` key on `review-mail`, bare array on `/wake`,
  no `kinds`/`actionableCount` on the listener envelope.
- The listener envelope must stay **body-free** (`tests/listener.test.js:22`
  invariant `parsed['messages'] === undefined`); the richer overview goes only on
  `review-mail` + `/wake`. The listener gets **counts-only** (`kinds` = lossless
  `counts` map + `actionableCount`), per approved-plan §3(b) and the v3.19.1
  listener contract.
- The plugin is JavaScript-only (no tsconfig); typecheck = `node --check
  <changed.js>`. Full suite = `node tests/run.js` (Windows: prepend
  `C:\Program Files\Git\bin` to PATH for the bash-stub tests). `tests/run.js`
  discovers `*.test.js`, skips `lib/`.
- **Three test consumers BEYOND the original approved plan** also assert on
  overview/listener output and must be updated for conformance: 
  `tests/listener-delivery-observability.test.js` (`:89-95`, v3.12.0),
  `tests/command-args-parity.test.js` (`overview.actionableCount` + off-mode
  `overview === undefined`), and
  `tests/integration/proactive-done-silent-miss.test.js` (`:62-70`, v3.19.1).

## Approach

### Architecture

Make `lib/review-kind-summary.js` the **single policy module** (mirrors the
`lib/collapse-*.js` precedent: pure leaf module, unit-tested directly, NOT
re-exported through `hooks/config.js`). Canonical exports:

- `NON_ACTIONABLE_KINDS = new Set(['progress','thread-fanout','thread-notification','member-joined','member-left'])`
- `NEEDS_ACTION_KINDS = new Set(['question','blocked','direct','operator-direct','operator-direct-summary','escalate-to-operator','member-crashed'])`
- `OVERVIEW_ACTIONABLE_CAP = 100`
- `parseOverviewEnv(env = process.env)` -> `{ enabled }` (`enabled === false` only
  when `CREWS_REVIEW_MAIL_OVERVIEW` lowercases/trims to `off`).
- `computeReviewKindSummary(records, opts?)` -> the `overview` object.
- `expandMessagesToKindRecords(messages)` -> pure; flattens raw consumed envelopes
  into `[{seq, sender, kind, summary}]`, expanding proactive `payload.entries[]` the
  same way `expandReviewRows` does (report kind + report seq per child; wrapper's own
  kind/seq for non-batch rows). **Listener-only.**

**Back-compat (decided):** keep the shipped **function names** as thin deprecated
aliases so the `review-mail.js` re-export surface and any external `require` keep
resolving — but the returned overview **shape** changes (the old fields `total`,
`firstActionable`, `lastActionable`, `summary`, `kinds` are removed). The shape
change is **documented** in CHANGELOG + AGENTS.md (this satisfies the task's
"document the shape change" back-compat option; we do NOT additionally preserve the
old field names as dual aliases — that would bloat the overview and re-introduce the
redundancy `firstActionable === actionable[0]`).
- `reviewOverviewEnabled(env)` = `parseOverviewEnv(env).enabled`
- `buildReviewKindSummary(input)` = `computeReviewKindSummary(expandMessagesToKindRecords(input))` (flatten-then-compute, returns the NEW shape)
- `flattenEntries(entries)` = `expandMessagesToKindRecords(entries)`
- `ACTIONABLE_KINDS` is **removed** (replaced by the denylist). Documented in CHANGELOG/AGENTS. (Its only consumer was the rewritten test.)

### `computeReviewKindSummary(records, opts?)` algorithm

`records` = `[{ seq, sender, kind, summary, inboxSeq?, collapsedCount?, body?, excerpt? }]`
(already-formatted display entries for review-mail/`/wake`; lightweight kind-records
for the listener). Pure; tolerant of null/missing fields.

For each record:
1. `kind = normalizeKind(record.kind)` — null/empty/whitespace -> `'direct'`
   (matches the existing `kindOf` no-kind→direct rule).
2. `weight = Number.isFinite(record.collapsedCount) && record.collapsedCount > 0 ? record.collapsedCount : 1`.
3. `counts[kind] = (counts[kind] || 0) + weight` (lossless, literal kind, NO `other` bucket).
4. Track `senders` insertion-ordered unique non-null `record.sender`.
5. If `kind ∉ NON_ACTIONABLE_KINDS`, push an actionable candidate
   `{ seq, sender, kind, summary: resolveSummary(record), needsAction: NEEDS_ACTION_KINDS.has(kind), inboxSeq }`
   (+ `collapsedCount` when `> 1`).

Then:
- `totalEntries = Σ weight`; `shownRows = records.length`.
- Sort actionable candidates ascending by `(seq ?? inboxSeq ?? +Inf)`, tiebreak by
  `inboxSeq`, final tiebreak by original input index (stable).
- `actionableCount = candidates.length` (TRUE, un-capped count of actionable
  **DISPLAY ROWS**, NOT `collapsedCount`-weighted).
- `needsActionCount = candidates.filter(c => c.needsAction).length` (also a
  **DISPLAY-ROW** count).

> **Two different measures — documented to remove the collapsed-actionable
> ambiguity (Phase-4 Copilot finding).** `counts` and `totalEntries` are
> **`collapsedCount`-weighted ORIGINAL totals** (lossless — nothing hidden), while
> `actionableCount`, `needsActionCount`, `shownRows`, and `actionable[].length` are
> **DISPLAY-ROW** counts. So three identical `done` rows that collapse into one
> display row give `counts.done === 3` (original) but contribute **1** to
> `actionableCount` (one display row), and the single `actionable[]` row carries
> `collapsedCount: 3` so the original multiplicity is recoverable per-row. This
> display-row definition is required for the cap to be coherent: the cap is on the
> `actionable[]` ARRAY length and `truncatedActionable` triggers when
> `actionableCount > cap`. Information is never lost — the original per-kind
> multiplicity lives in `counts`, and the per-row multiplicity lives in each
> `actionable[]` row's `collapsedCount`.
- **Truncation:** `cap = opts.cap ?? OVERVIEW_ACTIONABLE_CAP`. If
  `actionableCount > cap`: `actionable = [...candidates.slice(0, cap - 1), candidates[candidates.length - 1]]`,
  `truncatedActionable = true` (array length === cap, last actionable preserved).
  Else `actionable = candidates`, `truncatedActionable = false`.
- `resolveSummary(record)` = `record.summary` if non-empty; else first non-empty
  line of `record.body`/`record.excerpt` trimmed to ≤ 140 chars; else `''`. (Listener
  kind-records carry only `summary`, so they fall back to `''`.)
- **`headline`** (first field; format string):
  `actionable=<n> needsAction=<n> | done=<n> question=<n> blocked=<n> reply=<n> direct=<n> progress=<n> | total=<N> shown=<M> | latest-actionable: <kind> #<seq> <sender>: <summary≤80>`
  where the leading `actionable=`/`needsAction=` are the **display-row** counts
  (`actionableCount`/`needsActionCount`); the per-kind segment (`done=`/`question=`/
  `blocked=`/`reply= (counts['member-reply']||0)`/`direct=`/`progress=`) comes from
  the **`counts`** map (original/weighted totals); `total=<N>` = `totalEntries`,
  `shown=<M>` = `shownRows`; and `latest-actionable` = the actionable candidate with
  the MAX `seq` (`latest-actionable: none` when no actionable entries). Per-kind
  numbers default to 0 when the kind is absent.

Construct the returned object with `headline` FIRST (JS preserves key insertion
order through `JSON.stringify`, so a 2-space pretty-printed head-read shows the
headline immediately): `{ headline, totalEntries, shownRows, senders, counts,
actionableCount, needsActionCount, truncatedActionable, actionable }`.

### Consumer rewiring

- **`hooks/commands/review-mail.js`**: import `computeReviewKindSummary,
  parseOverviewEnv`; `handler()` -> `if (parseOverviewEnv().enabled) result.overview
  = computeReviewKindSummary(entries);`. `formatSuccess` unchanged (overview first
  when present). Update module.exports to export `computeReviewKindSummary,
  parseOverviewEnv` AND retain `buildReviewKindSummary, reviewOverviewEnabled`
  aliases. (`entries` are formatted display rows carrying
  `sender/kind/summary/seq/inboxSeq/collapsedCount/body/excerpt` — the exact
  `records` shape.)
- **`hooks/user-prompt-submit.js`** `/wake`:
  `parseOverviewEnv().enabled ? {overview: computeReviewKindSummary(entries), entries} : entries`.
- **`lib/listener-loop.js`** `deliver()`: replace the un-guarded block with
  ```js
  if (parseOverviewEnv(env).enabled) {
    try {
      const records = expandMessagesToKindRecords(messages);
      const overview = computeReviewKindSummary(records);
      envelope.kinds = overview.counts;          // lossless map; envelope field name stays "kinds"
      envelope.actionableCount = overview.actionableCount;
    } catch (_) { /* fail-open: omit kinds/actionableCount, never block delivery */ }
  }
  ```
  Counts-only; `messages` is never added; `consumeMailbox`/`markExited`/`finish` run
  regardless. The envelope `kinds` field NAME is unchanged (the value becomes the
  lossless counts map — for the existing seeds `{direct:2}`/`{done:1,...}` this is
  unchanged, so the pinned listener assertions stay green).

## Scope

### In Scope
- Rewrite `lib/review-kind-summary.js` to the approved lossless schema.
- Rewire the three consumers (review-mail, `/wake`, listener) to the new surface.
- Update all SEVEN test files (incl. the three beyond the original plan) + the
  mandatory 3-distinct-actionable regression.
- crews version bump (6 stamps) + marketplace sync + CHANGELOG + plugin AGENTS.md.

### Out of Scope
- Touching cursor-advance, collapse semantics, mailbox drain, epoch/consume logic,
  or the per-entry `formatReviewMailEntry` JSON shape.
- A `--summary-only`/quiet CLI mode; human/prose rendering mode; per-lead summary
  aggregation. (Deferred per the original plan §7.)
- Putting the richer overview (headline/actionable[]/senders) on the listener
  envelope — it stays counts-only (body-free).
- Any change outside `ai-developer-toolkit/plugins/crews/`. Do NOT touch codexu root
  `CLAUDE.md` (gitignored); fork-level edits go in the plugin `AGENTS.md`.

## Risk Areas
- **R1 — Listener delivery regression.** `deliver()` is load-bearing
  (epoch/consume). Mitigation: enrichment is fail-open (try/catch after consume),
  counts-only, env-gated, computed from a copy of `messages`. The
  `messages===undefined` test is the guard.
- **R2 — Existing listener assertions drift.** `tests/listener.test.js` /
  `listener-delivery-observability.test.js` pin `kinds.direct`/`kinds.done`/
  `actionableCount`. The lossless `counts` produces the SAME values for those seeds
  (literal kinds), so they should stay green — but the impl MUST run them and adjust
  only if a seed legitimately changes meaning under the denylist. Do not weaken the
  `messages===undefined` invariant.
- **R3 — Back-compat alias semantics.** `buildReviewKindSummary` now returns the NEW
  shape (old fields gone). The only internal callers are removed by the rewire; the
  alias is for external requires only. Document the shape change loudly.
- **R4 — Kind drift.** A brand-new envelope kind appears in lossless `counts`
  automatically and (being non-progress/non-notification) defaults to actionable —
  fail-safe toward surfacing. Only its `needsAction` classification would need a Set
  update.
- **R5 — Headline/ordering correctness.** `actionable` is seq-ordered and
  `latest-actionable` is max-seq; the central regression depends on the `done`
  (seq 22) being `actionable[0]` (it is the only actionable) and the max-seq latest.
  Pinned by tests.

## Acceptance Criteria
- **AC1** `lib/review-kind-summary.js` exports the canonical surface
  (`NON_ACTIONABLE_KINDS`, `NEEDS_ACTION_KINDS`, `OVERVIEW_ACTIONABLE_CAP`,
  `parseOverviewEnv`, `computeReviewKindSummary`, `expandMessagesToKindRecords`) plus
  the back-compat aliases (`reviewOverviewEnabled`, `buildReviewKindSummary`,
  `flattenEntries`). `node --check` clean.
- **AC2 (central regression)** A 21×`progress` + 1 trailing `done` batch yields
  `overview.counts.done === 1`, `overview.actionableCount === 1`,
  `overview.actionable[0].kind === 'done'`, and `overview.actionable[0].seq` = the
  done's seq. Pinned in `tests/review-kind-summary.test.js`.
- **AC3 (MANDATORY new test — the exact shipped gap)** A batch with 3+ DISTINCT
  actionable entries (e.g. `question@10`, `blocked@20`, `done@30` interleaved with
  progress rows) yields `overview.actionable` containing ALL THREE
  (`question`/`blocked`/`done`), seq-ordered, with correct `needsAction` flags.
- **AC4** Default `review-mail` output is `{overview, name, crew, entries, cursor,
  warning}` with `overview` before `name`; `overview` is the full approved object
  (`headline`, `totalEntries`, `shownRows`, `senders`, `counts`, `actionableCount`,
  `needsActionCount`, `truncatedActionable`, `actionable[]`). A read of the first ~25
  lines of the pretty-printed JSON for a 21-progress+1-done batch contains the `done`
  (in `headline` and `actionable`). Verified by a test slicing the serialized output.
- **AC5** `CREWS_REVIEW_MAIL_OVERVIEW=off` produces: `review-mail` with NO `overview`
  key (byte-identical top-level shape, `Object.keys` unchanged); `/wake` bare array;
  listener envelope omitting `kinds`/`actionableCount`. Pinned on all three surfaces.
- **AC6** Listener stdout envelope carries additive `kinds` (= lossless `counts`, with
  proactive `payload.entries[]` expanded) + `actionableCount`, while
  `parsed['messages'] === undefined` still holds; enrichment is fail-open (a thrown
  summary computation never blocks delivery — covered by a test).
- **AC7** `counts` is a lossless per-literal-kind map (no `other` bucket), weighted by
  `collapsedCount||1`; `member-reply`, `operator-direct`, `escalate-to-operator`,
  `member-crashed`, and `null`→`direct` each appear under their own key and (except
  progress/notifications) in `actionable`. `totalEntries` = Σ(collapsedCount||1);
  `shownRows` = display-row count; a trailing `done` is never collapsed into a
  progress run.
- **AC7b (collapsed-actionable semantics — explicit)** `actionableCount` and
  `needsActionCount` are **display-row** counts, NOT `collapsedCount`-weighted: a
  single collapsed actionable display row with `collapsedCount: 3` contributes **3**
  to `counts[kind]`/`totalEntries` but **1** to `actionableCount`, and its
  `actionable[]` row carries `collapsedCount: 3`. Pinned by a dedicated test
  (collapsed `done` head row: `counts.done === 3`, `actionableCount === 1`,
  `actionable[0].collapsedCount === 3`).
- **AC8** Truncation: a > cap-actionable batch yields `truncatedActionable: true`,
  `actionable.length === cap`, the LAST actionable entry present, and `actionableCount`
  = the true (un-capped) count.
- **AC9** crews version is `3.20.0` across all 6 stamps; `tests/version.test.js`
  passes; CHANGELOG `## 3.20.0` entry + AGENTS.md `## v3.20.0 …` section added;
  marketplace indexes synced (all via `scripts/bump-version.js 3.20.0`); Codex
  marketplace policy enum valid.
- **AC10** Full `node tests/run.js` suite green at default concurrency (incl. the
  three beyond-original-plan consumers); `node --check` clean on every changed `.js`.
  No change to cursor-advance, collapse semantics, mailbox drain, or the per-entry
  JSON shape.

## Suggested Decomposition

All work lives in the **same crews plugin** and is anchored on the **same helper
module** (`lib/review-kind-summary.js`): US-002/003/004 all depend on the US-001
rewrite, and US-005 stamps shared version/CHANGELOG/AGENTS/marketplace files. Per the
crews same-plugin rule, parallel execution would produce conflicting writes to the
helper, the version stamps, and the AGENTS/CHANGELOG prepends. **Serialize as one
job.**

### Cluster: review-mail-overview-conformance
- Stories: US-001, US-002, US-003, US-004, US-005
- Phase: 1
- Depends on: None
- File-overlap evidence: shared=`lib/review-kind-summary.js` (US-001 defines, US-002/003/004 consume), `CHANGELOG.md`/`AGENTS.md`/version stamps (US-005); exclusive=none across stories; risk=high (single shared module + shared release files)
- `execution_mode` rationale: All stories mutate or depend on one helper module and the shared release/doc files; running them in parallel guarantees merge conflicts. Run serially in one impl job, US-001 first.
